item.title: Suspicious Discontinuities
item.description:
📝 Some other discontinuities are the TANF income limit, the Medicaid income limit, the CHIP income limit for free coverage, and the CHIP income limit for reduced-cost coverage. Depending on your goals, this can often have impacts that are non-ideal. For example, in networking, a naive queue might be considered "unfair" to bursty workloads that have low overall bandwidth utilization because workloads that have low bandwidth utilization "shouldn't" suffer more drops than workloads that are less bursty but use more bandwidth (this is also arguably not unfair, depending on what your goals are).
🔗 Read more: https://danluu.com/discontinuities/

item.title: Researchers have developed pixels that can emit and analyse light together
item.description:
📝 These pixels can both steer light and analyse it. Fourier pixel use surface waves, which are scattered out as light waves. They capture the interference pattern of the scattered light from both waves with a camera.
🔗 Read more: https://ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/eth-news/news/2026/06/a-new-type-of-pixel.html
